## Context

Describe the problem and the affected user or workflow.

## Expected result

Describe what should happen.

## Reproduction

Provide deterministic steps and synthetic examples where applicable.

## Environment

Include the version or commit, Node.js version, npm version, operating system, architecture, and module system when relevant.

## Data safety

Do not include secrets, credentials, personal data, real customer records, or vulnerability details. Use the private security reporting channel for suspected vulnerabilities.
